abstract:
Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a heterogeneous autoimmune disease. The association between ABO blood groups and RA remains inconclusive, with most studies limited to serological phenotypes and lacking molecular typing, and the modifying role of FUT2 secretor status is unclear.
We enrolled 557 R A patients and 1114 healthy controls matched by age and sex. Seven ABO alleles were genotyped by optimized two-dimensional PCR (2D-PCR), and the full-length FUT2 coding region was Sanger-sequenced with an automated double-peak interpretation tool. Conditional logistic regression assessed ABO-RA associations and serological subtype heterogeneity, and tested ABO-FUT2 interaction.
The 2D-PCR system achieved 100% signal interpretation across 16 ABO genotypes. FUT2 sequencing revealed seven novel variants (c.92C > G, c.611G > T, c.239G > T, c.819C > A, c.179G > T, c.768delT, and the cis-configured c.921_922insTT + c.924 A > T). Carriage of ABO*A1.02 or ABO*O.01.02 was associated with 34% (OR = 1.34, P = 0.012) and 33% (OR = 1.33, P = 0.015) increased RA risk, respectively (Bonferroni-significant). The ABO*B.01/ABO*O.01.01 genotype showed a suggestive protective signal (OR = 0.66, P = 0.044) but not in the dominant model. Serological stratification suggested suggestive trends in the RF-positive and CCP-positive subgroups, although these did not survive correction. Case-only analysis found no direct association between these genotypes and autoantibody positivity; however, this analysis cannot determine whether ABO influences autoantibody production or acts through other mechanisms. No significant ABO-FUT2 interaction was detected (LRT P = 0.539).
Carriage of ABO*A1.02 or ABO*O.01.02 was associated with increased RA risk in this cohort, with suggestive trends in seropositive subtypes, and this association was not modified by FUT2 secretor status. The mechanism underlying this association remains to be determined. These variants may be candidates for future functional studies.

summary: In 557 RA patients and 1114 controls, ABO*A1.02 and ABO*O.01.02 carriage linked to higher RA risk, unmodified by FUT2 secretor status.
title: ABO*A1.02 and ABO*O.01.02 are associated with rheumatoid arthritis risk and are not modified by FUT2 secretor status.
